source: Kit folders sampled key by key; names are <timestamp>_<note><octave>7f0000 (velocity 7f). Korg octaves: C2 = MIDI 36 (checked: C2 is a dull hit, D2 bright, F#2 a short bright hat, C#3 a long crash). The drum is then the General MIDI key. 'BD kit' holds kicks only; the BD & SD and percussion kits don't follow GM, so their key guesses are low confidence.
